segments.ja393:1.1: Susukhaṃ vata jīvanti, ye janā vighāsādino;
segments.ja393:1.3: Diṭṭheva dhamme pāsaṃsā, samparāye ca suggatī.
segments.ja393:2.1: Sukassa [suvassa (sī. syā. pī.)] bhāsamānassa, na nisāmetha paṇḍitā;
segments.ja393:3.1: Nāhaṃ tumhe pasaṃsāmi, kuṇapādā suṇātha me;
segments.ja393:4.3: Vighāseneva yāpentā, mayaṃ ce bhoto gārayhā;
segments.ja393:6.1: Ye brāhmaṇassa samaṇassa, aññassa vā [aññassa ca (sī. syā.), aññasseva (pī.)] vanibbino [vaṇibbino (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja393:6.3: Datvāva [datvāna (pī. ka.)] sesaṃ bhuñjanti, te janā vighāsādinoti.
